expectations.evidence: HashMap<TypeId, HashMap<usize, Box<dyn Component>>> storage. Type-erased via Component trait + Any. impl_component! macro for registration. Scalable.
System trait with run(&self, world: &mut World). Four system implementations. Scheduler with Vec<Box<dyn System>>.
World::query method accepts a slice of TypeIds, returns entities matching all. Systems use this to query by component combination.
Adding Pickup component demonstrated in main() with impl_component! macro. No changes to World or existing systems. Entity uses generation counter for stale handle detection (nice touch).
